About.postTitle: Shipping with AI agents without losing control of the “how”
About.postDesc: What building CoCapital taught me about letting agents make architecture decisions, and what I changed.
About.mkDesc: Not everyone learned at the same pace, so I turned an AI workshop into a self-paced manual, answered questions along the way, and built a tool to produce those manuals.
About.adNow: For students in Peru getting into university. Right now: an admissions results portal.
About.coDesc: A shared-capital tracker for partners. It started with two friends and S/ 1,000.
About.trDesc: An electronic invoicing API for Peruvian developers, built on SUNAT’s rules.
About.p1: I'm Daniel Guzman, a fullstack engineer from Lima, Peru. I build learning products with AI.
About.p2: I work remotely as a fullstack engineer at Kilo, a US fitness-tech company. I also mentor and facilitate AI workshops at MakerLab Perú.
About.p3: Right now I'm building Admitidos, for students in Peru getting into university, and writing about what I learn along the way.

Project-CoCapital.postTitle: Shipping with AI agents without losing control of the “how”
Project-CoCapital.postDesc: What building CoCapital taught me about letting agents make architecture decisions, and what I changed.
Project-CoCapital.mkDesc: Not everyone learned at the same pace, so I turned an AI workshop into a self-paced manual, answered questions along the way, and built a tool to produce those manuals.
Project-CoCapital.adNow: For students in Peru getting into university. Right now: an admissions results portal.
Project-CoCapital.coDesc: A shared-capital tracker for partners. It started with two friends and S/ 1,000.
Project-CoCapital.trDesc: An electronic invoicing API for Peruvian developers, built on SUNAT’s rules.
Project-CoCapital.problem: Two friends pooled S/ 1,000 and tracked it in a messy spreadsheet. Nobody was sure how much each partner had, or who owed what.
Project-CoCapital.built: Partners log movements in seconds, see the shared capital in real time, and lend money with an auto-generated payment schedule.
Project-CoCapital.how: With AI agents, and learning not to let them make the architecture decisions for me. The full story is in the post below.
